Cut to 2023 we welcomed our second child Koa into the world before resuming full-time travel around the world.

recentItems.title: 48 Hours in Singapore (Sentosa Island)
recentItems.description:
Visit: http://www.squarespace.com/flyingthenest - Welcome back to Singapore everyone as we hop off the Disney Adventure and go spend 48 hours on Singapore's man-made island - Sentosa Island. This is everything we got up to during our weekend away.

Thanks to Shangri-La Sentosa for hosting our stay: https://bit.ly/4eU9EQ8
